$schema_note: aiglasses.lifelog design tokens v2 (studio polish, 2026-11-20). Web maps these to Tailwind theme + CSS variables. Palette: archive paper/ink with pine-green accent, ochre-red detection, amber uncertainty.

synthetic.label_zh-CN: 合成示例日 · 研究原型

contrast: Body text >= 7:1 (AAA) on paper; card body (secondary ink #47433C on #F6F3EC) >= 8.9:1; UI text and badges >= 4.5:1; focus ring 3 px solid accent + 3 px offset.

font.licenses: All SIL OFL 1.1, self-hosted via next/font; no third-party font CDN at runtime.
font.roles: Serif (Newsreader): headings, section titles, pull quotes, daily-summary prose only. Sans (Inter): body, card text, spoken transcript text, captions. Mono (JetBrains Mono): timestamps, numbering, status, uncertainty chips. All times and numerals use tabular-nums.

heat.note: Contact-sheet (year heatmap) 5-step scale, levels 0-4. Dark scale tops out at warm taupe, never near-white, to avoid glare for low-vision readers.

motion.reduce_motion: all transitions 0 ms; no auto-scroll animation

type_floor: No readable text below 13px (0.8125rem, --text-xs). Card body text is 15px Inter in secondary ink.
